connector.why: Same image of Israel in Egypt as a fetus enclosed by Egypt's impurity (גוי מקרב גוי) and exile as preparation for Torah through suffering (Berachot 5a, 600,000 souls).
Same Bereshit Rabbah 11 and Shabbat 118 nachala bli metzarim promised to Yaakov when he left, tied to ושמרתיך בכל אשר תלך.
Same Tanchuma Ki Tavo / Re'eh 11 / Shabbat 118b chain on mitchat'in, bikkurim and Shabbat granting the heart's requests.
Shares Zohar I 148b and Lam 1:6 by citation only; its theme is Yaakov as Adam before the sin, not exile.
Ishbitz–Radzin list: opens Vayetzei with ופרצת ימה and Isaiah 58 (Shabbat delight, nachalat Yaakov); develops Shabbat delight and freedom through the yoke of Heaven.

found.why: Third meal = nachala bli metzarim with no kelipah, tied to והאכלתיך נחלת יעקב and the revelation of Atika.
Yaakov's going out as exile and Motza'ei Shabbat; Shabbat's boundless inheritance as holiness accompanying Israel into exile.
Maharal on why the Haggadah opens with Lavan who sought to uproot all: causeless enmity recurring in every generation.
Israel as reishit for whom Bereishit was written, joined with Shabbat delight and nachalat Yaakov.
